research_goal: every 10 minutes reconstruct the current hydraulic state from sparse causal sensing, learn how all 109 writable facilities change future system-wide cumulative TFV, evaluate all 109 facilities for immediate and delayed control value, optimize a predicted-beneficial multi-facility action sequence, execute the first 10-minute target, then re-observe

core_pipeline.step1: causal sparse sensing -> current full-network hydraulic reconstruction
core_pipeline.step2: causal current state + causal rainfall + complete reference/candidate H360 actions -> authoritative exact delta TFV
core_pipeline.step3: HOLD is exact zero; screen all 109 facilities with pulse and persistent probes, optimize predicted-beneficial facilities, execute if optimized predicted delta TFV < 0, otherwise HOLD
core_pipeline.swmm: authoritative offline label generator and authoritative control evaluation truth; never the online candidate evaluator

time_contract.terminal_tail: hold the final H120 target through H360

action_contract.reason: all 109 facilities are evaluated, while continuous H120 optimization is limited to the predicted-beneficial dynamic subset so the 10-minute controller remains computationally practical
action_contract.engineering_bounds: per-facility physical min/max plus <=0.5 setting movement per 10-minute update
action_contract.support_bounds: TrainFit q95 action magnitudes are retained as optimization geometry; they are not an additional action-admission threshold

step2_current.primary_target: authoritative exact SWMM delta TFV relative to same-prefix reference
step2_current.model: shared pairwise V(candidate)-V(reference), decomposed into 109 facility value differences plus multi-facility interaction value difference
step2_current.reference_representation: complete H360 reference and candidate sequences through the same value network
step2_current.zero_action_contract: candidate == reference -> exact predicted delta TFV zero
step2_current.antisymmetry_contract: swapping candidate/reference negates predicted delta exactly
step2_current.main_stage: exact single-facility branches train 109 facility main-value differences with facility-balanced regression
step2_current.joint_stage: multi-facility branches train the interaction residual without HOLD decision bias
step2_current.control_stage: D3 HOLD-reference TrainFit groups only; late value representation receives symmetric sign calibration for the actual online act-vs-HOLD decision
step2_current.top1_policy: exact cached-candidate top1 is diagnostic only; primary control evidence is selected true delta TFV, regret, harmful fraction, pairwise ordering and sign
step2_current.dev_group_counts: 112 D2 FIT + 112 D3 FIT + 33 D4 FIT; audit on 32 D2 holdout + 32 D3 holdout + 15 D4 AUDIT
step2_current.109_facility_learning_gate: full DEV fails closed only if exact single-facility TrainFit coverage is below 109/109
step2_current.d4_role: reference-shift stress diagnostic; poor D4 selection does not block HOLD-reference Step3
step2_current.action_support_artifact: checkpoint.action_support stores per-facility action coverage/support and joint changed-facility quantiles

step3_current.screening: for all 109 facilities evaluate up/down probes at half/full first-move radius under both one-block pulse and persistent H360 patterns, so delayed-benefit facilities remain eligible
step3_current.beneficial_definition: facility best pulse/persistent probe predicted delta TFV < 0
step3_current.active_set: rank all predicted-beneficial facilities; default ceiling is TrainFit joint changed-facility q90, not q50
step3_current.optimization: bounded L-BFGS-B across 12 free 10-minute blocks for the dynamic active set
step3_current.admission: no separate calibrated threshold; execute when optimized predicted delta TFV < 0, otherwise HOLD
step3_current.execute: first 10-minute target only; re-observe before the next decision
step3_current.solver_only_gate: must screen 109/109, obey physical/rate/support geometry, complete inside the control period, and generate at least one action before authoritative SWMM evaluation

data_boundaries.D2: primary single-facility attribution and long-duration numeric supervision
data_boundaries.D3: HOLD-reference temporal/joint supervision and online control-reference supervision
data_boundaries.D4_FIT: Sparse-RBC-reference local first-move training/stress data; not the runtime reference

promotion_rule: prove 109/109 facility learning and useful D3 HOLD-reference held-out control value, then run Step3 directly, then validate the exact first move with authoritative Development SWMM
